display.excerpt: Frontmatter is used to add metadata to Markdown files. It's placed at the top of the Markdown file enclosed in --- lines. You can access frontmatter variables in the markdown body using the frontmatter keyword enclosed in brackets. For a list of each available property, refer to the PageFrontmatter API .

title: Example Page
---
